questions.q: How old was the Prophet SAW when he wanted to go to Sham with Abu Talib?
questions.explain: At age 12 he begged not to be left behind.

questions.q: What is meant by a daif hadith?
options: A weak hadith that does not meet the conditions of sahih or hasan
questions.explain: The Tirmidhi hadith about Bahira is graded daif.

questions.q: What did Ibn Kathir and adh-Dhahabi conclude about the reports of the Bahira story?
questions.explain: They analysed all reports and found none strong, so we need not turn it into a polemic.

questions.q: Who are orientalists in the context of this lecture?
options: Western scholars of the East and Islam
questions.explain: Some orientalists tried to prove the Prophet SAW took knowledge from monks.

options: An important pact the Prophet SAW joined in his twenties
questions.explain: Hilf al-Fudul was an important pact in Makkan society.

questions.q: What happened when he wanted to listen to singing as a youth?
questions.explain: Allah protected the Prophet SAW before prophethood from indecency.

options: One who does not worship idols and seeks the religion of Prophet Ibrahim
questions.explain: A Hanif who went against the tide can be an example.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW did not learn about Jews and Christians from any monk; it was all revelation.
questions.explain: True. The Prophet's knowledge came from revelation.

questions.q: The ustaz says the Prophet SAW struck a child just once.
questions.explain: False. The Prophet SAW never struck a child, not even once.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A Christian monk living at a place of worship
Jews and Christians who have earlier scriptures
A caravan stop on the Syrian border
A mark on the Prophet's back in the Tirmidhi report

questions.explain: Busra is a caravan stop, a rahib is a Christian monk, Ahl al-Kitab are Jews and Christians, and the sign of prophethood is the mark on his back in the Tirmidhi report.

questions.q: Your child has a confusing first experience. What does the ustaz advise?
options: Be the place your child can talk, don't shut your eyes
questions.explain: Parents should not bury their heads like an ostrich.
